note: NOT a gameval catalog. These are revision-727 cache archive and file names for index 23 (world_map), recovered from the index's own 32-bit name hashes and re-verified against them. A world-map static-element file is one placed map icon, addressed by its JS5 (archive, file) coordinate rather than by any type id, so it gets no catalog for the same reason index-5 map squares get none - see gamevals/CONTRACT.md, "Index 23 (world_map)". The 45 world-map AREAS this index also names DO have a catalog: gamevals/worldmap.json. Unlike the index-5, 30 and 31 names, these do not follow a formula and cannot be rebuilt from a rule, so they are kept verbatim here as reference data. Nothing loads this file; see docs/cache-archive-names.md.

channels.hash: the name re-hashes to the cache's recorded name hash and came from a rule whose whole candidate space is under the CONTRACT proof budget (world_map_area: 92 candidates, 2.7e-05 expected false hits; world_map_static_element: 10712 candidates over the RS3-949 mapelement vocabulary, 3.16e-03)
channels.brute: the name re-hashes to the cache's recorded name hash but was found by dictionary-constrained search over a large space and accepted on the CONTRACT `brute` gate (cheap generating region); corroborated, not proof
